title: Telescopes
info: A telescope gathers light so faraway things look brighter and more detailed.
A refracting telescope uses lenses. A reflecting telescope uses mirrors.
Galileo used a telescope to study the sky. Never point a telescope at the Sun unless it has a special solar filter.

options: studying the sky with a telescope

options: the best way to see stars at noon
